questions.question: Mina, now a national reference in oral medicine, is invited to an international congress. What message should she convey?
options: Oral medicine is a model of diagnostic excellence
Oral medicine is reserved for specialists
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Oral medicine is a model of diagnostic excellence.' 🦅 Sami: 'I am proud of you.'

questions.question: Sami must create a foundation to promote oral medicine. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Promoting screening and prevention is essential for the future.' 🐆 Mina: 'I will support this foundation.'

questions.question: Mina must write a reference work on oral medicine. What is the central message?
options: Oral medicine is an exact science
Oral medicine is an art that combines observation and analysis
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Oral medicine is an art that combines observation and analysis.' 🦅 Sami: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Sami must give a closing speech at an international congress. What note should he leave?
options: Oral medicine is in full evolution, full of opportunities
Oral medicine is of no interest
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Oral medicine is in full evolution, full of opportunities.' 🐆 Mina: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Mina must create a mentoring program in oral medicine. What is the main objective?
options: Transmit fundamental skills in oral medicine
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Mentoring transmits fundamental skills in oral medicine.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will support this program.'

questions.question: Sami must manage the succession of his expertise in oral medicine. What is the best strategy?
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Progressive preparation for transmission is the key to a successful succession.' 🐆 Mina: 'I will help you.'

questions.question: Mina must create a charter for oral medicine. What is the fundamental pillar?
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Diagnostic rigor and prevention are the pillars of any oral medicine charter.' 🦅 Sami: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Sami must train future mentors in oral medicine. What is the first message to convey?
options: Mentoring is a mission of support and transmission
Mentoring is a source of income
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Mentoring is a mission of support and transmission.' 🐆 Mina: 'I will convey this message.'

questions.question: Mina must prepare a testimony on her career in oral medicine. What is the most striking element?
options: The joy of making accurate diagnoses
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The joy of making accurate diagnoses is the most striking element.' 🦅 Sami: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Sami must create an alumni association for oral medicine. What is the main objective?
options: Maintain the bond and promote mutual aid
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Mutual aid and the bond are the driving forces of an alumni association.' 🐆 Mina: 'I will support this association.'

questions.question: Mina must write an article on the future of oral medicine. Which trend should be emphasized?
options: The decrease in needs for oral medicine
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Innovation serving diagnosis is a promising trend.' 🦅 Sami: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Sami must create a quality label for oral medicine. What are the main criteria?
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Quality of diagnosis and management are the fundamental criteria.' 🐆 Mina: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Mina must give a farewell speech to the profession. What message should she leave?
options: The profession needs enthusiasts of oral medicine
The profession is of no interest
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The profession needs enthusiasts of oral medicine.' 🦅 Sami: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Sami must create an award for young dentists in oral medicine. What is the purpose?
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Excellence in oral medicine is the driving force of the profession's evolution.' 🐆 Mina: 'I will support this award.'

questions.question: Mina must write her memoirs. What common thread should be highlighted?
options: The passion for oral medicine and service to patients
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The passion for oral medicine is the common thread of a professional life.' 🦅 Sami: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Sami must create a training center for oral medicine. What is the vision?
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Training should produce diagnostic professionals.' 🐆 Mina: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Mina must leave a legacy to the profession. What is the most beautiful legacy?
options: Skills in oral medicine and an example to follow
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Skills in oral medicine and an example to follow are the most beautiful legacy.' 🦅 Sami: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Sami must write a letter to future dentists about oral medicine. What message should he convey?
options: Oral medicine is a fascinating discipline
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Oral medicine is a fascinating discipline.' 🐆 Mina: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Mina must create a scholarship for students in oral medicine. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Supporting deserving students is an investment for the future.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will support this initiative.'

questions.question: Sami must give a closing speech. What note should he leave?
options: Oral medicine continues to evolve with those who carry it
Oral medicine is of no interest

Oral medicine is of no interest

Oral medicine is of no interest
